nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md

nodes.summary: Defines community expectations, incident reporting, and enforcement for project contributors and participants.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md

nodes.name: Launch LoRA Studio.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows one-click launcher that installs uv when needed, synchronizes the Python 3.14 environment, safely replaces the LoRA Studio server on port 8504, and opens the application.
nodes.languageNotes: Batch control flow delegates process inspection and startup to an embedded PowerShell command.

nodes.name: Launch LoRA Studio.sh
nodes.summary: Linux launcher that installs uv when needed, creates the locked Python 3.14 environment, replaces a prior LoRA Studio server, and starts Streamlit on port 8504.
nodes.languageNotes: The script uses strict Bash mode and a PID file to identify the server it owns.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview and primary onboarding guide covering features, hardware requirements, GitHub installation, Hugging Face access, launchers, first training, and project boundaries.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: States supported versions, private vulnerability reporting, security controls, and safe operating guidance for the local training application.

nodes.name: TECHNICAL.md
nodes.summary: Technical reference for the Streamlit architecture, data and job lifecycles, training implementation, storage, inference, credential boundaries, and testing strategy.

nodes.name: USAGE.md
nodes.summary: End-user operating guide for system readiness, Hugging Face access, launch, data and model selection, training, monitoring, shutdown, and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Defines the Python 3.14 package, Streamlit console entry point, CUDA 13 PyTorch index, runtime dependencies, build backend, and development tools.
